text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "ElCom", "gist": "ElCom is the subject of the text"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It is responsible for monitoring compliance with the Swiss Federal Electricity Act and the Swiss Federal Energy Act, taking all necessary related decisions and pronouncing rulings where required.", "gist": "ElCom monitors compliance with Swiss electricity and energy laws and makes decisions/rulings"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "ElCom monitors electricity prices and rules as a judicial authority on disputes relating to network access and payment of cost-covering feed-in of electricity produced from renewable energy.", "gist": "ElCom monitors electricity prices and adjudicates disputes over network access and renewable energy feed-in payments"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It also monitors electricity supply security and regulates issues relating to international electricity transmission and trading.", "gist": "ElCom also oversees electricity supply security and regulates international electricity transmission/trading"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Postal Services Commission PostCom", "gist": "PostCom is another entity mentioned in the text"}]}
